decision_rule.B1: P1 C7-C1 at least 0.005 with source CI lower bound > 0
decision_rule.B2: P3 C5-C3 or P4 C4-C3 at least 0.005 with source CI lower bound > 0
decision_rule.B3: speech-state contrast P5 does not explain at least 60% of positive P6 residual damage
decision_rule.B4: C7 onset or transition excess over its matched stable stratum has source CI lower bound > 0 and at least 0.005
decision_rule.B5: relevant LOSO signs are consistent and positive donor-seed count is at least four
decision_rule.conditional: background-related point estimates are material but one or more primary CIs cross zero or source/donor stability fails
decision_rule.invalid: matching, baseline, or intervention validity fails
decision_rule.residual: B1 and B2 fail while P6 C7-FULL is material with CI lower bound > 0
decision_rule.speech_state: P5 is material with CI lower bound > 0 and explains at least 60% of positive P6
decision_rule.unresolved: no mechanism separates the replacement conditions

event_matching.S1_ONSET_NEAR: match each speech frame with onset distance 0-5 to the nearest non-overlapping stable-speech frame in the same item, same ground-truth label, and stable speech run length at least 21
event_matching.S2_TRANSITION_NEAR: match each Short-posterior transition frame with absolute switch age 0-5 to the nearest non-overlapping stable frame in the same item, same ground-truth label, and stable run length at least 21
event_matching.S3_OFFSET_NEAR: match each non-speech frame with offset distance 0-5 to the nearest non-overlapping stable-silence frame in the same item, same ground-truth label, and stable silence run length at least 21

event_rules.stable_silence: ground-truth silence run length at least 21
event_rules.stable_speech: ground-truth speech run length at least 21

event_strata.S1_ONSET_NEAR: ground-truth speech with onset distance 0-5 frames
event_strata.S3_OFFSET_NEAR: post-speech non-speech with offset distance 0-5 frames
event_strata.S4_STABLE_SPEECH: speech run length at least 21 frames
event_strata.S5_STABLE_SILENCE: silence run length at least 21 frames

b4_event_pairing.S1_ONSET_NEAR: match each speech frame with onset distance 0-5 to the nearest non-overlapping stable-speech frame in the same item, same ground-truth label, and stable speech run length at least 21
b4_event_pairing.S2_TRANSITION_NEAR: match each Short-posterior transition frame with absolute switch age 0-5 to the nearest non-overlapping stable frame in the same item, same ground-truth label, and stable run length at least 21
b4_event_pairing.S3_OFFSET_NEAR: match each non-speech frame with offset distance 0-5 to the nearest non-overlapping stable-silence frame in the same item, same ground-truth label, and stable silence run length at least 21

matching.b4_matching_variable: Short uncertainty abs(short_score - 0.5), with frame index only as a deterministic tie break
matching.c1_rule: same utterance, different causal anchor, remote vector positions disjoint from the original remote positions, and donor causal window strictly before target frame
matching.c2_rule: same noise instance and same SNR; different utterance
matching.c3_rule: same noise class and same SNR; different noise instance, utterance, and source
matching.c4_rule: same noise class; different noise instance, utterance, and source; absolute SNR difference at least 10 dB
matching.c5_rule: different noise class; same SNR; different utterance and source; RMS/state costs minimized
matching.c6_rule: same noise class and SNR; different utterance and source; remote speech-state mismatch at least 0.25
matching.c7_rule: same noise class and SNR; different source, noise instance, and utterance; simultaneous cost matching for speech-state composition, RMS, and duration

S1_ONSET_NEAR.imported_definition: ground-truth speech frames with frames-since-onset in frozen bins 0, 1-2, or 3-5

S2_TRANSITION_NEAR.imported_definition: age of the most recent Short-prediction switch in the current utterance in frozen bins 0, 1-2, or 3-5

S3_OFFSET_NEAR.imported_definition: post-speech ground-truth non-speech frames in frozen bins 0, 1-2, or 3-5

S4_STABLE_SPEECH.imported_definition: ground-truth speech run length at least 21 frames, using the frozen 21-50 and longer run bins

S5_STABLE_SILENCE.imported_definition: ground-truth silence run length at least 21 frames, using the frozen 21-50 and longer run bins

event_strata_provenance.import_rule: E2 imports these definitions from already frozen CAR/AE/AX3 protocols and does not redefine windows or run thresholds after outcome inspection.

pre_outcome_implementation_corrections: Remote speech-state features now index full-history labels at the original causal frame positions.
C7 now requires same noise class and SNR as hard candidate constraints before deterministic metadata cost matching.

primary_contrasts.definition: C7 minus C1; positive means different-source replacement is more harmful
primary_contrasts.name: P1_UTTERANCE

primary_contrasts.definition: C3 minus C2; positive means class-only replacement is more harmful
primary_contrasts.name: P2_NOISE_INSTANCE

primary_contrasts.definition: C5 minus C3; positive means class mismatch adds damage
primary_contrasts.name: P3_NOISE_CLASS

primary_contrasts.definition: C4 minus C3; positive means SNR mismatch adds damage
primary_contrasts.name: P4_SNR

primary_contrasts.definition: C6 minus C3; positive means speech-state mismatch adds damage
primary_contrasts.name: P5_SPEECH_STATE

primary_contrasts.definition: C7 minus FULL; positive means residual replacement damage remains
primary_contrasts.name: P6_RESIDUAL_IDENTITY
